For some [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] fans, a [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] pilot will be enough of a skill set to demand this guy's inclusion already! But don't forget his ability in your big blue deck. He's an informant for the Empire, so he can radio in a Star Destroyer for support if the going gets a little hot. You may need to be doing some tracking, but if you get it right it is not only a free Star Destroyer, and immune to anything that cancels 'reacts' (it is not a react), but it is also a probably low destiny off the top of your deck for the coming battle! Well played!

And remember, this guy is eligible for inclusion in an ISB deck!

Fly [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]], fly!!
